title: Two Weeks
one_paragraph_synopsis: In 'Two Weeks,' Michael prepares to leave the office to start his own paper company, leading to chaotic departures and staff reactions. The episode explores Michael’s plans, his interactions with colleagues, and the staff's responses to his exit.
